segments.text: A large percentage of a chemist's time in the laboratory is spent purifying chemicals.
segments.zh: 化学工作者在实验室里有很大一部分时间都花在纯化化学品上。

segments.text: Learning to use a variety of different purification techniques efficiently and effectively is key to becoming a successful experimentalist.
segments.zh: 学会高效、有效地使用各种纯化技术，是成为一名成功实验工作者的关键。

segments.text: Re-crystallization is one powerful method for the purification of crystalline solids.
segments.zh: 重结晶是纯化晶态固体的一种强有力的方法。

segments.text: This video will outline the purification of naphthalene by re-crystallization.
segments.zh: 本视频将概述用重结晶法纯化萘的过程。

segments.text: The technique of re-crystallization involves five main steps.
segments.zh: 重结晶技术包括五个主要步骤。

segments.text: First, an appropriate solvent is determined.
segments.zh: 首先，确定合适的溶剂。

segments.text: Re-crystallizations can be carried out using either one or a mixture of two solvents, depending on the solubility of the sample.
segments.zh: 重结晶可以用单一溶剂，也可以用两种溶剂的混合物，取决于样品的溶解性。

segments.text: Next, the sample is dissolved in a minimal amount of the proper hot solvent.
segments.zh: 接着，把样品溶解在最少量的合适热溶剂中。

segments.text: At this point, the solution can be decolorized and insoluble contaminants can be removed by performing a hot filtration.
segments.zh: 此时，可以对溶液进行脱色，并通过热过滤除去不溶性杂质。

segments.text: The resulting solution is then cooled to induce crystallization.
segments.zh: 然后将所得溶液冷却，以诱导结晶。

segments.text: And finally, the purified crystals are collected by filtration, washed, and dried.
segments.zh: 最后，通过过滤收集纯化后的晶体，并进行洗涤和干燥。

segments.text: This video will first outline the general procedure for carrying out a one-solvent re-crystallization of naphthalene,
segments.zh: 本视频将首先概述萘的单溶剂重结晶的一般操作步骤，

segments.text: followed by instructions for adapting the procedure to a two-solvent re-crystallization.
segments.zh: 然后说明如何把该步骤调整为双溶剂重结晶。

segments.text: Choosing an appropriate solvent for a re-crystallization is a very important step.
segments.zh: 为重结晶选择合适的溶剂是非常重要的一步。

segments.text: You won't get acceptable results if you don't pick carefully.
segments.zh: 如果不仔细选择，你就得不到满意的结果。

segments.text: It is helpful to have a variety of solvents at your disposal.
segments.zh: 手头备有多种溶剂会很有帮助。

segments.text: If solubility data for your compounds has been published, this will help you to narrow the range of potential candidates.
segments.zh: 如果你的化合物已有公开发表的溶解度数据，这将帮助你缩小候选溶剂的范围。

segments.text: Once you have decided on a few prime contenders, you will perform solubility tests to find the ideal choice.
segments.zh: 一旦确定了几个主要候选溶剂，你就要做溶解性测试来找出最理想的选择。

segments.text: You will need a hot water bath for the solubility tests as well as the re-crystallization.
segments.zh: 溶解性测试和重结晶都需要用到热水浴。

segments.text: Caution. Organic solvents are flammable. Never heat over an open flame.
segments.zh: 注意！有机溶剂是易燃的。绝不要用明火加热。

segments.text: To set up a water bath, place a large crystallizing dish about half full with water on a hot plate.
segments.zh: 搭建水浴时，把一个约半满水的大结晶皿放在加热板上。

segments.text: Add some boiling stones and turn on the heat. Don't turn it up all the way. Start halfway and adjust from there.
segments.zh: 加入一些沸石并打开加热。不要一下开到最大，先开到一半，再从那里调节。

segments.text: To perform a solubility test, place approximately 20 milligrams of your compound in a test tube.
segments.zh: 做溶解性测试时，取约 20 毫克化合物放入试管。

segments.text: Add a half of a milliliter of the appropriate solvent and swirl.
segments.zh: 加入半毫升相应的溶剂并旋摇。

segments.text: Wait a couple of minutes and then make note of whether or not the compound dissolves.
segments.zh: 等几分钟，然后记录化合物是否溶解。

segments.text: For example, at room temperature, naphthalene is insoluble in ethanol and water, but soluble in toluene and acetone.
segments.zh: 例如，在室温下，萘不溶于乙醇和水，但溶于甲苯和丙酮。

segments.text: If there is still solid remaining, clamp the tube and heat it in the water bath until the solvent boils.
segments.zh: 如果仍有固体残留，就把试管夹好，在水浴中加热直至溶剂沸腾。

segments.text: Swirl the tube and make note of whether or not the compound dissolves.
segments.zh: 旋摇试管，并记录化合物是否溶解。

segments.text: After heating, naphthalene is still insoluble in water, but it is now soluble in hot ethanol.
segments.zh: 加热后，萘仍然不溶于水，但现在溶于热乙醇了。

segments.text: Now that you have finished the solubility test, how do you decide which solvent to use for your recrystallization?
segments.zh: 做完溶解性测试后，你该如何决定重结晶用哪种溶剂呢？

segments.text: The ideal solvent is one in which your compound is insoluble at room temperature, but soluble at the boiling point.
segments.zh: 理想的溶剂是：你的化合物在室温下不溶，但在沸点时可溶。

segments.text: Remember, at room temperature, naphthalene was soluble in both toluene and acetone, so neither of these will work.
segments.zh: 记住，在室温下，萘在甲苯和丙酮中都可溶，所以这两种都不行。

segments.text: After heating, naphthalene remained insoluble in water, even at the boiling point.
segments.zh: 加热后，萘在水中仍不溶，即使在沸点也不溶。

segments.text: This means that ethanol is the solvent of choice. It dissolves the sample at its boiling point, but not at room temperature.
segments.zh: 这意味着乙醇是首选溶剂。它在沸点时能溶解样品，在室温下则不能。

segments.text: Now that we have decided on a solvent, it is time to dissolve the sample in some hot ethanol.
segments.zh: 既然选定了溶剂，现在就该把样品溶解在一些热乙醇中了。

segments.text: Get ready by heating some ethanol in the water bath.
segments.zh: 先在水浴中加热一些乙醇做好准备。

segments.text: Remember to add some boiling stones and clamp the flask securely so that it doesn't tip over.
segments.zh: 记得加一些沸石，并把烧瓶牢固夹好，以免倾倒。

segments.text: Place the sample in an Erlenmeyer flask, but before adding solvent, it is a good idea to set aside a small crystal.
segments.zh: 把样品放入锥形瓶，但在加溶剂之前，最好先留出一小粒晶体。

segments.text: It may come in handy later if you have trouble getting crystals to form.
segments.zh: 如果之后你难以让晶体析出，它可能会派上用场。

segments.text: When dissolving your sample, use a minimal amount of hot solvent.
segments.zh: 溶解样品时，要用最少量的热溶剂。

segments.text: This will ensure good recovery of crystals in the end.
segments.zh: 这样才能确保最后有较好的晶体回收率。

segments.text: Add hot solvent in small amounts, swirling and heating in between each addition until the sample just dissolves.
segments.zh: 少量多次地加入热溶剂，每次加入之间都要旋摇并加热，直到样品恰好溶解。

segments.text: Caution! If it won't dissolve, it's probably an impurity.
segments.zh: 注意！如果有东西怎么都不溶，那很可能是杂质。

segments.text: Now that the sample is in solution, impurities can be removed through decoloration and hot filtration.
segments.zh: 样品溶解后，就可以通过脱色和热过滤来除去杂质。

segments.text: Take a close look at the solution. Is it the right color?
segments.zh: 仔细观察溶液。颜色对吗？

segments.text: For example, if you're expecting white crystals and your solution is yellow, then there is a soluble impurity.
segments.zh: 例如，如果你预期得到白色晶体，而溶液是黄色的，那就说明存在可溶性杂质。

segments.text: One easy way to remove small amounts of colored impurities is with activated charcoal.
segments.zh: 除去少量有色杂质的一个简便方法是使用活性炭。

segments.text: Before adding any charcoal, cool your solution to slightly below the boiling point.
segments.zh: 在加入活性炭之前，先把溶液冷却到略低于沸点。

segments.text: Caution! Adding charcoal to a boiling solution will cause it to boil over.
segments.zh: 注意！往沸腾的溶液中加入活性炭会导致溶液暴沸溢出。

segments.text: Add a small amount of charcoal to absorb the impurity.
segments.zh: 加入少量活性炭来吸附杂质。

segments.text: Do not add too much or the charcoal will also absorb your compound.
segments.zh: 不要加太多，否则活性炭也会吸附你的化合物。

segments.text: Swirl the flask and boil it in the water bath for 2 to 3 minutes.
segments.zh: 旋摇烧瓶，并在水浴中煮沸 2 到 3 分钟。

segments.text: Charcoal is very fine and can be hard to remove by filtration.
segments.zh: 活性炭非常细，很难通过过滤除去。

segments.text: It is easiest to add a small amount of a filtering agent, such as sea light, to absorb the charcoal and facilitate the filtration.
segments.zh: 最简便的做法是加入少量助滤剂，如硅藻土（Celite），来吸附活性炭并方便过滤。

segments.text: Add only a small amount, swirl the flask, and heat it once again for 2 to 3 minutes before performing a hot filtration.
segments.zh: 只需加入少量，旋摇烧瓶，再加热 2 到 3 分钟，然后进行热过滤。

segments.text: If the solution is colorless, the decoloration step is unnecessary, but you still need to look carefully for any undissolved solid in the flask.
segments.zh: 如果溶液是无色的，就不需要脱色这一步，但你仍需仔细检查烧瓶中是否有未溶解的固体。

segments.text: If you find any, it can be removed by performing a hot gravity filtration with fluted filter paper.
segments.zh: 如果发现有，可以用扇形滤纸进行热的常压过滤将其除去。

segments.text: Vacuum filtrations cool the solution too much and crystals are lost on the filter paper and funnel.
segments.zh: 减压过滤会使溶液冷却过多，晶体会损失在滤纸和漏斗上。

segments.text: Before filtering your solution, add some excess solvent and heat it to the boiling point to ensure that the compound stays dissolved during the filtration.
segments.zh: 过滤溶液之前，先加入一些过量的溶剂并加热至沸腾，以确保化合物在过滤过程中保持溶解。

segments.text: Wet the filter paper with some hot solvent and filter the solution.
segments.zh: 用一些热溶剂润湿滤纸，然后过滤溶液。

segments.text: Rinse the flask 2 or 3 times with hot solvent, filtering each rinse.
segments.zh: 用热溶剂淋洗烧瓶 2 到 3 次，每次的淋洗液都要过滤。

segments.text: Finally, rinse the filter paper with hot solvent to minimize product loss.
segments.zh: 最后，用热溶剂淋洗滤纸，以尽量减少产物损失。

segments.text: Crystals frequently form in the filtrate during the filtration, but they easily re-dissolve with heating.
segments.zh: 过滤过程中，滤液中经常会析出晶体，但加热后很容易重新溶解。

segments.text: Caution, your compound is no longer dissolved in a minimum amount of solvent.
segments.zh: 注意，你的化合物现在已经不是溶解在最少量的溶剂中了。

segments.text: Before proceeding to the next step, you need to boil away the excess solvent.
segments.zh: 在进行下一步之前，你需要把多余的溶剂煮掉。

segments.text: Remember to add a few boiling stones to the solution and boil until solid begins to form.
segments.zh: 记得往溶液中加几粒沸石，煮沸直到开始有固体析出。

segments.text: At this point, add a small amount of hot solvent to re-dissolve the solid.
segments.zh: 这时，加入少量热溶剂使固体重新溶解。

segments.text: When your sample is once again dissolved in the minimum amount of solvent, set it aside to cool.
segments.zh: 当样品再次溶解在最少量的溶剂中时，把它放在一边冷却。

segments.text: Cover the flask to prevent contamination with airborne particles and allow it to cool to room temperature undisturbed.
segments.zh: 盖住烧瓶，防止空气中的颗粒污染，并让它在不受扰动的情况下冷却到室温。

segments.text: The flask can also be placed in a beaker, stuffed with a paper towel, to slow down the cooling and promote slow crystal growth.
segments.zh: 也可以把烧瓶放进塞有纸巾的烧杯里，以减缓冷却、促进晶体缓慢生长。

segments.text: This is especially helpful in a cold laboratory.
segments.zh: 在寒冷的实验室里，这样做尤其有用。

segments.text: Ideally, crystals will begin to form as the solution cools.
segments.zh: 理想情况下，随着溶液冷却，晶体会开始析出。

segments.text: You may want to watch. It can be very beautiful.
segments.zh: 你可能会想看一看，那景象可能非常美丽。

segments.text: If the solution reaches room temperature without crystal growth, you may want to try a trick or two to jump start the process.
segments.zh: 如果溶液冷却到室温仍没有晶体生长，你可能要试一两个小窍门来启动这个过程。

segments.text: First, try scratching the side or bottom of the flask with a glass rod.
segments.zh: 首先，试着用玻璃棒刮擦烧瓶的侧壁或底部。

segments.text: Don't press too hard or you'll break it.
segments.zh: 不要用力太大，否则会把它弄破。

segments.text: If that doesn't work, try adding the seed crystal that you set aside at the beginning.
segments.zh: 如果这样不行，就试着加入你一开始留出的那粒晶种。

segments.text: If you forgot to set aside a seed crystal, you can also try dipping a glass rod in the solution,
segments.zh: 如果你忘了留晶种，也可以试着把玻璃棒蘸进溶液里，

segments.text: letting it dry so that the minute crystals form on the surface, and then dipping it back in.
segments.zh: 让它干燥，使其表面形成微小的晶体，然后再把它蘸回去。

segments.text: When crystallization has begun and your flask is at room temperature, place it in an ice bath to drive the crystallization to completion.
segments.zh: 结晶开始且烧瓶已降到室温后，把它放进冰浴中，使结晶完全。

segments.text: Leave it in the ice bath for at least 15 minutes before collecting the crystals.
segments.zh: 在冰浴中至少放置 15 分钟，然后再收集晶体。

segments.text: The final step in a recrystallization is collecting and washing the purified crystals.
segments.zh: 重结晶的最后一步是收集并洗涤纯化后的晶体。

segments.text: To do this, you will need a flask of ice cold solvent, ethanol in this case, and a vacuum filtration setup.
segments.zh: 为此，你需要一瓶冰冷的溶剂（本例中是乙醇）和一套减压过滤装置。

segments.text: Always use a clean, dry flask to collect the filtrate.
segments.zh: 务必用洁净干燥的烧瓶收集滤液。

segments.text: In many cases, a second batch of crystals can be obtained by concentrating the mother liquor and crystallizing a second time.
segments.zh: 在许多情况下，可以浓缩母液并进行第二次结晶，得到第二批晶体。

segments.text: Turn the vacuum on and wet the filter paper with a small amount of cold solvent.
segments.zh: 打开真空，用少量冷溶剂润湿滤纸。

segments.text: Pour the crystals and the mother liquor onto the funnel using cold solvent to transfer all of the crystals from the flask.
segments.zh: 把晶体和母液倒到漏斗上，用冷溶剂把烧瓶中的晶体全部转移过来。

segments.text: Use cold solvent to wash the crystals and pull air through them to begin the drying process.
segments.zh: 用冷溶剂洗涤晶体，并抽气通过晶体，开始干燥过程。

segments.text: After pulling air through the crystals for a few minutes, scrape the crystals onto a weighing dish and spread them out to facilitate drying.
segments.zh: 抽气几分钟后，把晶体刮到称量皿上并铺开，以便干燥。

segments.text: Depending on the compound, the crystals can be dried in a desiccator, an oven, or on a vacuum line.
segments.zh: 根据化合物的不同，晶体可以在干燥器中、烘箱中或真空管路上干燥。

segments.text: When one ideal solvent cannot be found for a crystallization, it is possible to use a mixture of two solvents.
segments.zh: 当找不到一种理想的单一溶剂来结晶时，可以使用两种溶剂的混合物。

segments.text: Once again, you must choose the solvents very carefully.
segments.zh: 同样，你必须非常仔细地选择溶剂。

segments.text: In the first solvent, solvent 1, your sample should be soluble even at room temperature.
segments.zh: 在第一种溶剂（溶剂 1）中，你的样品即使在室温下也应该可溶。

segments.text: And in the second solvent, solvent 2, your sample must remain insoluble even at the boiling point.
segments.zh: 而在第二种溶剂（溶剂 2）中，你的样品即使在沸点也必须保持不溶。

segments.text: The two solvents must also be miscible at all ratios so that they don't separate out into different layers during the recrystallization.
segments.zh: 两种溶剂还必须能以任意比例互溶，以免在重结晶过程中分成不同的液层。

segments.text: We know from our solubility test that naphthalene is soluble in both toluene and acetone even at room temperature.
segments.zh: 从溶解性测试我们知道，萘即使在室温下也能溶于甲苯和丙酮。

segments.text: So which one should we choose to be our solvent 1?
segments.zh: 那么我们应该选哪一种作为溶剂 1 呢？

segments.text: That depends entirely on our choice for solvent 2.
segments.zh: 这完全取决于我们对溶剂 2 的选择。

segments.text: We know from our solubility test that naphthalene is insoluble in water even at the boiling point.
segments.zh: 从溶解性测试我们知道，萘即使在沸点也不溶于水。

segments.text: That makes water a very good candidate for solvent 2.
segments.zh: 这使得水成为溶剂 2 的一个很好的候选。

segments.text: While acetone and water are miscible, toluene and water are not.
segments.zh: 丙酮和水能互溶，而甲苯和水则不能。

segments.text: The recrystallization of naphthalene will be carried out using acetone as solvent 1 and water as solvent 2.
segments.zh: 萘的重结晶将用丙酮作溶剂 1、水作溶剂 2 来进行。

segments.text: As before, dissolve your sample in the minimal amount of hot solvent, in this case, solvent 1, acetone.
segments.zh: 和之前一样，把样品溶解在最少量的热溶剂中，这里是溶剂 1，即丙酮。

segments.text: Add just enough hot solvent to obtain a clear solution.
segments.zh: 加入的热溶剂刚好足以得到澄清溶液即可。

segments.text: Then add solvent 2, in this case water, dropwise until the solution turns cloudy.
segments.zh: 然后逐滴加入溶剂 2（这里是水），直到溶液变浑浊。

segments.text: Whirl and heat the solution to make sure that the cloudiness persists.
segments.zh: 旋摇并加热溶液，确认浑浊持续不消失。

segments.text: And do not confuse cloudiness with the turbidity that is observed upon mixing two solvents together.
segments.zh: 不要把这种浑浊与两种溶剂混合时观察到的混浊现象混淆。

segments.text: Once you have obtained a persistently cloudy solution, add hot solvent 1 dropwise until the solution just turns clear.
segments.zh: 得到持续浑浊的溶液后，逐滴加入热的溶剂 1，直到溶液恰好变澄清。

segments.text: Now you're ready to set the solution aside to cool.
segments.zh: 现在就可以把溶液放在一边冷却了。

segments.text: Once the crystallization is complete, cool down a mixture of solvents in a ratio similar to that which you recrystallized from.
segments.zh: 结晶完成后，按照与重结晶时相近的比例配制一份混合溶剂并冷却。

segments.text: This cold mixture will be used to collect and wash your crystals.
segments.zh: 这份冷的混合溶剂将用来收集和洗涤你的晶体。

segments.text: Remember, this video is intended to help you prepare for lab by providing a demonstration of the proper experimental technique.
segments.zh: 记住，本视频旨在通过演示正确的实验技术，帮助你为实验做好准备。

segments.text: It is not intended as a replacement for reading your lab manual or the supplementary material.
segments.zh: 它并不能代替阅读你的实验手册或补充材料。

segments.text: In order to become a great experimentalist, it is important that you understand both theory and technique.
segments.zh: 要成为一名优秀的实验工作者，重要的是既要理解理论，也要掌握技术。

segments.text: Now it's your turn. Good luck.
segments.zh: 现在轮到你了。祝你好运。
